messages:
maria (Sales): Procurement asks for a single SIG/CAIQ-friendly paragraph about encryption/KMS. They need clear yes/no style bullets too.
diego (Solutions Eng): Draft paragraph: "Redwood enforces TLS 1.3 for all network traffic and AES-256-GCM for data at rest. We implement envelope encryption: DEKs are used for data encryption and are themselves wrapped with customer or provider CMKs. Customers may supply CMKs via supported cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) or integrate HSM-backed keys for Private/on-prem deployments (KMIP/PKCS#11 supported). Redwood does not export customer CMKs; only wrapped key material is transmitted. Key operations (wrap/unwrap/rotate) are logged and available in the compliance bundle; HSM attestation artifacts are provided by the HSM vendor where applicable."
maria (Sales): Can someone turn that into quick yes/no bullets they can drop into the vendor portal?
diego (Solutions Eng): Sure: 
- In-transit encryption: Yes (TLS 1.3).
- At-rest encryption: Yes (AES-256-GCM).
- BYOK via cloud KMS: Yes (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- HSM-backed keys: Yes (Private/on-prem only; vendor attestation provided).
- Do keys leave customer account?: No (customer CMKs remain in-customer account when provided).
- Rotation support: Yes (customer-managed or Redwood-managed rewrap; configurable cadence, emergency rotation supported).
tara (Security): Add: "We never persist plaintext master keys. Audit logs for key operations are immutable and can be exported for vendor risk reviews. If Redwood performs any key generation on behalf of a customer it is a documented, scoping engagement."
sam (Prospect Sec): They also want a line about timelines: how long for HSM integration in a POC?
diego (Solutions Eng): Typical POC hookup: 2-4 weeks (network, KMIP endpoint, attestation review, validation). Customer infra needs to provide allowlist and KMIP credentials.
ci-bot: Presales crypto template updated -> https://redwood.internal/sales/presales-crypto (revision 9)
maria (Sales): Perfect. I'll paste the paragraph + bullets into procurement and attach the POC checklist. Actions: diego add quick ARN example to repo; tara attach standard attestation + audit excerpts. Sam, will that cover your procurement needs?
sam (Prospect Sec): Yes, that's exactly what legal asked for. Thanks everyone.
